# Holds comment markers as content.
greeting = "# not a comment"
single = '# not a comment either'
interpolated = "#{greeting} # not a comment after interpolation"
percent = %q(# not a comment in a percent literal)
pattern = /# not a comment in a regexp/
char = ?#
notes = <<~NOTES
  # not a comment inside a heredoc
NOTES
puts greeting, single, interpolated, percent, pattern, char, notes
__END__
# not a comment after __END__
